title: Physical violence
meaning: Hitting, kicking, pushing or any physical harm to you by anyone, including peers, adults or family.
examples_and_warning_signs: Injuries or bruises you cannot or do not want to explain
Fear of a particular person or place
steps: Get medical care for any injury.
Write down what happened, when and who saw it.
seek_immediate_help: You are injured or in pain
The person may hurt you again soon
school_support: Principal and school safeguarding or child protection staff
